summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Quote Line Item Editing and Room Grouping features. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified and working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing quote OFF-2026-93572A for testing. Temporarily modified description and restored after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quote Line Item Editing and Room Grouping features fully implemented and tested. All features working: 1) Description field is now editable in QuoteDetailPage.js edit mode (previously only quantity and unit_price were editable). 2) Subtitle items (item_type='subtitle') render as dark red room headers with uppercase text (bg: rgb(122, 31, 31)). 3) Subtotal items (item_type='subtotal') render with left red border showing room subtotal amount. 4) Subtitle and subtotal rows do NOT have edit/delete buttons. 5) Backend PUT /api/quotes/{quote_id}/items/{item_id} accepts description field in LineItemUpdate model. 6) generate-quote-from-calculation endpoint creates subtitle/subtotal items for room grouping.

Admin Login.details: POST /api/auth/admin/login works with liam/Liammail123, returns session_token

Get Quote Items.details: GET /api/quotes/{quote_id}/items returns line items including subtitle/subtotal types

Update Line Item Description.details: PUT /api/quotes/{quote_id}/items/{item_id} with description field updates correctly and persists

Update Line Item All Fields.details: PUT endpoint accepts description, quantity, unit_price together and recalculates totals

Subtitle/Subtotal Not Counted in Totals.details: Adding subtitle/subtotal items with vat_rate=0 does not affect quote totals

Generate Quote From Calculation.details: POST /api/projects/{project_id}/generate-quote-from-calculation creates subtitle/subtotal items for room grouping

LineItemUpdate Model Accepts Description.details: Backend LineItemUpdate Pydantic model includes Optional[str] description field

UI Description Edit Field.details: QuoteDetailPage.js shows editable text input for description in edit mode (data-testid='edit-description-{id}')

UI Subtitle Styling.details: Subtitle items render with dark red background (rgb(122, 31, 31)), uppercase text, no edit/delete buttons

UI Subtotal Styling.details: Subtotal items render with left red border (3px solid rgb(122, 31, 31)), show room subtotal amount, no edit/delete buttons
